items.does: A user can list the program's authoring documents, create one (optionally from an authoring template), and edit its sections in the rich editor. Saves carry a reason for change. The user can also comment and resolve comments, cite sources, ask AnA to draft a section (needs an AI provider), accept or reject tracked changes, e-sign, freeze, export DOCX/PDF, file the document into the Vault and place it into a filing slot. Every one of these steps goes to the live /api/authoring store and is audited.
